explication: Lawnchair is an Android home app built on Launcher3, combining a home-screen launcher with Pixel-inspired features and customization. The principal workflow begins with a user interacting with the launcher and ends in home-screen content or an invoked action. Global search, widget picking, theming, icon/font customization, At a Glance, and Recents integration are distinct product branches. The tree and README identify these capabilities, but most implementation excerpts were not supplied; links between their modules are therefore limited to the documented workflow rather than asserted internal calls.
